title: Zelensky Warns Russia Preparing New Wave of Missile Strikes Against Ukraine
detail: President Zelensky issued a warning on May 29, 2026 (Day 1,555) that Russia is preparing a new wave of missile strikes against Ukraine, prompting raised air-alert levels across multiple regions. The warning comes amid continued active front-line fighting and follows a pattern of large-scale Russian missile and drone barrages. Ukrainian air defense units have been placed on heightened readiness in anticipation of imminent strikes.

media.caption: Zelensky warns Russia is preparing a new wave of missile and drone strikes, prompting air alert readiness across Ukraine — Day 1,555

title: Russian Shahed Drone Crashes into Romanian Apartment in Galati — First Injury on NATO Soil; Emergency Council Convened
detail: On May 29, 2026 (Day 1,555), a Russian Geran-2/Shahed-type drone targeting Ukraine during an overnight barrage strayed into NATO territory and crashed into the roof of a 10-story residential apartment building in Galati, Romania, injuring 2 people and sparking a fire requiring immediate evacuations. It was the first time anyone was injured by a Russian drone striking Romanian soil. Romania's Supreme Defense Council convened an emergency session and declared it the 'worst incident to hit national territory' since Russia's invasion began. NATO and EU members immediately condemned Russia. US Ambassador to NATO Matthew Whitaker called it a 'reckless incursion into NATO territory.' Romania demanded accelerated transfer of anti-drone capabilities from NATO allies. Putin denied Russia's responsibility but declined to provide specifics. The incident heightened fears about escalation to NATO territory and demonstrated Russian disregard for alliance borders.

media.caption: Russian Geran-2 drone crashes into 10-story apartment building in Galati, Romania — 2 injured, first drone casualty on NATO soil; Romania calls emergency defense council
